name: bond-cockpit
description: Cockpit for bond: the current job (task, tool in flight, agent and workflow progress), prompt-cache hit rate and time to expiry in the status line and a docked pane that also lists the session's models and the rate-limit, context and cost usage, with a toast before the cache expires. A mod of function hooks; needs a Claude Code build with plugin hooks modules.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto infers it (overage → 5m, a model switch's report, else 1h on a subscription and 5m on an API key); 5m or 1h fixes it

cacheWarnSeconds.title: Cache expiry warning (seconds)
cacheWarnSeconds.description: How long before the cache expires the toast fires; 0 turns it off
